A_naming_mismatch.description: Object IDs/names diverge from gold but relation structure is largely correct

C_partial_naming.description: Partial overlap with gold naming convention

D_edge_binding_detail.description: Object identification mostly correct but edge/binding details differ

B_structural_mismatch.description: True structural failure — scene topology diverges from gold

defensible_interpretation: ~62% of asset_routing failures are naming/labeling mismatches (Patterns A+C); the compiler produces structurally valid scenes with correct topology and bindings, but object naming conventions diverge from the gold standard. The true algorithmic failure rate is ~12.7% (Pattern B: structural mismatch), not 91.7%.
